objective: Quantify the oracle maximum movement in nMAE, fidelity, Jaccard, and reach when only off-diagonal VCC panel response genes are changed and all non-panel predictions remain fixed.

scaled_nmae_calibration.method: fit affine raw-to-official mapping from already-recorded runs on the same H1-test reference bundle

exact_prediction_de_table.identity: legacy repaired-HCT116 production prediction at g0.65_q1.0_a1.08_spread0.25; used only for exact-table fidelity, Jaccard, and reach ceilings, not represented as current a14

target_cohort: Exact intersection of each reused surface's target labels with the canonical 300 VCC panel targets. Target-self is always immutable and excluded.

reference_composition.reference_de_panel_fraction: Number of finite, nonzero, reference-significant off-diagonal VCC panel response genes divided by the full finite, nonzero, reference-significant gate size.
reference_composition.reference_abs_lfc_panel_fraction: Sum absolute reference LFC over those panel genes divided by sum absolute reference LFC over the full gate.
reference_composition.aggregation: Compute per target first, then arithmetic mean over evaluable target rows within each surface; the three-surface macro is an equal-weight mean of surface macros.

nmae.incumbent: Exact deterministic predicted LFC from the frozen incumbent mean profile against the cached reference control mean.
nmae.unconstrained_perfect_panel_oracle: Replace every mutable panel predicted LFC in the reference-significant gate by its reference LFC independently; leave every non-panel predicted LFC and target-self unchanged.
nmae.zero_to_perfect_panel_fraction: Reference absolute-LFC panel fraction; this is the raw NMAE movement from zero prediction to perfect panel prediction, not necessarily the incumbent correction.
nmae.scaled_gain: Where an exact affine local raw-to-scaled mapping is derivable from already-recorded same-bundle results, multiply raw gain by the absolute fitted slope. Otherwise report null.

fidelity_oracle.availability: Only where an exact incumbent prediction DE table already exists.
fidelity_oracle.fixed_part: All non-panel predicted calls, signs, and adjudicability remain fixed.
fidelity_oracle.mutable_part: The panel call set and signs may be chosen independently for this metric.
fidelity_oracle.optimization: Enumerate the number of correctly signed adjudicable mutable-panel calls from zero through all available panel coordinates and maximize k/max(n_pred,n_real). Current panel calls are replaced, not added.

jaccard_oracle.availability: Only where an exact incumbent prediction DE table already exists.
jaccard_oracle.fixed_part: All non-panel predicted calls remain fixed.
jaccard_oracle.mutable_part: Choose exactly the reference-significant mutable panel genes and no other panel calls, which maximizes intersection while adding no panel false positives.

reach_oracle.availability: Only where an exact incumbent prediction DE table already exists.
reach_oracle.fixed_part: The relative order and predicted signs of all non-panel genes in the reference-significant pool remain exactly as in the incumbent table.
reach_oracle.mutable_part: Every reference-significant mutable panel gene is assigned the correct sign and placed before the fixed non-panel sequence.
reach_oracle.bound: Run the exact deepest-prefix purity calculation at 0.9 on that concatenated sequence. This respects the metric's nonmonotone deepest-prefix semantics.

pan_handling.use: No Pan values or outcome arrays are loaded by Experiment 127.
pan_handling.reason_not_in_metric_ceiling: No scorer-equivalent genome-wide reference significance table and incumbent prediction DE table are available for Pan.

buildable_transport.reason: Experiment 124 was independently rejected because q*exp(r) mixes units and its per-gene floor check does not preserve the summed emitted panel budget.
